notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
Hi all, this new version has some improvements:

added a minimap (m key/select button)
levels improved & rebalanced
small changes to some enemies
sound & vfx improvements
added a hiscore list
various bugfixes.


Enjoy!

Next milestones:
